description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rendmaw, adding {C}{C}.
When Rendmaw dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Rendmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Rendmaw enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bird, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
